name: Laneway Festival 2027
intro: Laneway is back for 2027 with a smaller, four-city run. For the first time, Sydney opens the festival, and Brisbane returns after a year on the Gold Coast. Adelaide and Perth miss out this time, though Fontaines D.C. are playing their own headline shows in both cities.
tips: Hayley Williams' own Sydney and Melbourne shows sold out, so Laneway is the only other way to see her solo set this trip.
Some local acts play individual cities only. Check the festival site for each city's bill.
Set times usually drop in the week before. We'll add them here when they're out.

name: Golden Plains 2027
intro: Golden Plains returns to the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre in country Victoria for the Labour Day long weekend, with Geese and Underworld at the top of the bill. It's a camping festival with one stage, so everyone sees the same shows.
tips: It's a one-stage festival, so there are no clashes.
Bring a camping set-up that can handle hot days and cold nights. Meredith in March can swing a long way.
Golden Plains runs a no-dickhead policy. Look after each other.

name: Castaway Festival 2027
intro: Castaway is a one-day festival of big Australian acts, with Hilltop Hoods, Violent Soho and Amy Shark leading the 2027 bill. After Wollongong on 20 March (already on sale), it heads to Torquay in April and Sandstone Point in May.
tips: The Torquay and Sandstone Point presale runs from 11am local time on Monday 30 November to 11am on Tuesday 1 December.
General tickets go on sale at 12pm local time on Tuesday 1 December, through the festival website only.
Torquay is an all-ages show.

name: ULTRA Australia 2027
intro: ULTRA's big electronic weekend returns with Melbourne's Flemington Racecourse on the Saturday and ULTRA Beach on the Gold Coast on the Sunday. The first line-up is out, with a second wave of acts still to come.
tips: I Hate Models plays the Gold Coast only so far.
One Melbourne headliner is yet to be revealed.
Tickets for both events are sold through the ULTRA Australia website.

name: Froth & Fury 2027
intro: Adelaide's one-day heavy music festival returns with Knocked Loose headlining and a new fourth stage, The Hothouse. The full line-up is now locked in.
tips: Kids under 10 get in free.
Death Angel are playing an Act III set.
Final release tickets are on sale now.

name: Superposition 2026
intro: A brand-new arts and music festival spread across the Blue Mountains and Penrith, with a Block Party curated by Hermitude and Haiku Hands, a queer arts takeover in Katoomba, and gigs in local pubs and bars.
dates: Venues around Katoomba and the upper Blue Mountains
Venues around Katoomba and the upper Blue Mountains
tips: Events run across Penrith, Katoomba, Blackheath, Mount Victoria, Medlow Bath and Wentworth Falls, so check each event's location before you go.
Tickets are sold per event through the festival's ticket page.

name: Spilt Milk 2026
intro: Spilt Milk tours four cities over two December weekends, with Lewis Capaldi (playing Australia only for this festival) and Raye on top. Geelong takes over from Ballarat as the Victorian stop this year.
tips: General admission went out in staged releases, with prices climbing each release.
Add-on packages cover things like express entry, private toilets and bars, and elevated viewing.

name: Lost Paradise 2026
intro: Lost Paradise marks 20 years of its promoters with a five-day New Year camping festival in Glenworth Valley, about an hour north of Sydney. John Summit, Skepta, KI/KI and Overmono lead a bill heavy on house, techno and drum and bass.
lineup: James Pepper B2B Baron Von Trax
tips: Every ticket includes general camping.
Stages include Arcadia, Lost Disco and Paradise Club, with an art hub at Shambhala Fields.

name: Beyond The Valley 2026
intro: Beyond The Valley starts its second decade at Barunah Plains in western Victoria, with John Summit, Black Eyed Peas, Vince Staples and The Veronicas on New Year's Eve and KI/KI playing a three-hour set on opening night.
tips: Headliners are spread across the days, so check the day-by-day line-up before planning your arrival.
The 2025 edition sold out in under an hour.

name: Woodford Folk Festival 2026/27
intro: The 39th Woodford Folk Festival fills Woodfordia, north of Brisbane, for six days over New Year, mixing folk and roots with rock, cabaret, First Nations culture and talks. DZ Deathrays make their debut alongside Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos and The Dreggs.
tips: Day and season tickets are sold with or without camping.
Stardust Songwriters runs a nightly folk club in an alcohol-free area.
The festival closes with the Sunrise Ceremony on New Year's Day.

name: Wildlands 2026/27
intro: Wildlands brings a one-day dance and hip-hop festival to Brisbane on New Year's Eve and Perth two days later, led by John Summit, Skepta and an Australian-exclusive set from WORSHIP.
tips: There are three stages: the open-air Sahara Stage, the tented Summit Stage and the new Wilds Stage.

name: South West Dub Fest 2027
intro: After a sold-out first year, this sound-system festival at Cheeky Monkey Brewing in Wilyabrup grows to two evenings, with France's O.B.F. on the Sunday and the Red Earth Sound System running all weekend.
tips: Under-12s get in free with a ticketed parent or guardian, but need to be registered ahead.
There's no camping on site, so book accommodation nearby.
Return buses run from Margaret River, Cowaramup and Dunsborough for $25 a day, sold separately.

name: Tamworth Country Music Festival 2027
intro: The 55th Tamworth Country Music Festival takes over the whole city for ten days, with Lee Kernaghan and Troy Cassar-Daley headlining at TRECC and the Golden Guitar Awards on the final Saturday.
tips: Shows run at venues all over town, including the Town Hall, Capitol Theatre, The Longyard and the Bluebird Room.
Toyota Park has a themed day most days, from Americana in the Park to a Bluegrass Hoedown.
Hundreds more free and ticketed shows are still being added to the program.

name: Boyup Brook Country Music Muster 2027
intro: WA's biggest country music festival turns 40 in Boyup Brook, with the WA Country Music Awards held over the weekend. Line-up to be announced.
tips: Temporary community campsites are set up within walking distance of the Music Park.

name: Nannup Music Festival 2027
intro: The 38th Nannup Music Festival fills the small South West town with folk, roots and world music across ten free and ticketed stages over the Labour Day long weekend, with Kasey Chambers, Mia Dyson and The Inspector Cluzo among more than a hundred acts.
lineup: Delilah Rose & the All Star Ladies of Rock
tips: There's a festival campground, and campers are asked to leave the car there and ride the Cruisy Bus into town.
Some stages are free and others ticketed.
Kids' activities and workshops run through the weekend.

name: National Folk Festival 2027
intro: The National Folk Festival gathers the folk community in Canberra over the Easter long weekend for five days of music, dance and workshops. The first artists are on the festival site, with more names still to come; line-up to be announced in full.
tips: Early bird tickets are on sale through the festival website.

name: Rolling Sets 2026
intro: Rolling Sets pairs a beachside skate program with a big indie and rock bill, returning to Duranbah Beach at Tweed Heads and adding Newcastle's Nobbys Beach. Ocean Alley, G Flip and Violent Soho top the line-up.
tips: Ocean Alley's sets are exclusive to these two shows.
The Need2Freak stage runs DJs alongside the main stage.
The Newcastle site is grassed, so some areas can be tricky for wheelchairs.

name: Good Things 2026
intro: The heavy music festival hits Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane on consecutive days, with Limp Bizkit, Simple Plan and Spiritbox leading a bill that also has Alexisonfire playing 'Crisis' and Millencolin playing 'Pennybridge Pioneers' in full.
tips: It's a 16+ event in every city.
Ministry are billed as playing their farewell Australian shows.
Chad Gray's set covers both Mudvayne and Hellyeah songs.

name: Meredith Music Festival 2026
intro: The 34th Meredith returns to the Supernatural Amphitheatre on the Nolan farm, with Dijon, Eddy Current Suppression Ring and The Dandy Warhols among the names on its single stage. It's independent, unsponsored and puts its proceeds back into the Meredith community.
lineup: City Of Ballarat Municipal Brass Band
tips: Tickets go out by ballot, and a ticket covers camping and parking.
There's one stage, so no clashes.
The No Dickhead Policy applies.

name: Field Day 2027
intro: Field Day turns 25 with an all-dance New Year's Day party in The Domain, led by Major Lazer on their first Australian visit in 11 years, plus Sub Focus and a secret headliner still to be revealed.
tips: It's a one-day event in the city, not a camping festival.
There are three stages, including the Casamigos Camp Ground curated by the LGBTQIA+ community.

name: Illawarra Folk Festival 2027
intro: The Illawarra Folk Festival marks its 40th anniversary at Bulli Showground, with more than 100 acts across eight venues on site over three days. Line-up to be announced.
tips: You can camp on site.
Bulli station is a short walk from the showground, and there's parking on site.

name: Cobargo Folk Festival 2027
intro: The volunteer-run Cobargo Folk Festival celebrates its 30th year at the town's showground on the NSW far south coast, with England's Kate Rusby, Ireland's Eleanor McEvoy and The Spooky Men's Chorale among close to 70 acts.
lineup: Den Hanrahan and the Rum Runners
Suzanne Petersen and Big John Ling
tips: Camping on the showground is for weekend ticket holders only and must be booked online with your ticket; under-12s camp free.
Shuttle buses run from Narooma, Tilba, Wallaga Lake and Bermagui ($10 a trip or $50 for the weekend).
No glass and no pets.

name: Blue Mountains Music Festival 2027
intro: The Blue Mountains Music Festival brings three days of folk, roots and blues concerts and workshops to seven undercover stages a short walk apart in Katoomba. The Milk Carton Kids, Kate Rusby and Newton Faulkner lead the bill so far.
tips: Full-weekend, day and night tickets are available.
All seven stages are undercover and within a few minutes' walk of each other.
The full program comes out closer to the festival.
